evals.prompt: Use research-council-cdx to review this idea: train a language model to generate synthetic peer reviews, then fine-tune the same model on those reviews to improve its scientific reasoning.
evals.expected_output: Automatically selects quick tier, runs only the three required independent reviewer seats before Chair synthesis, marks findings unverified, and produces the unchanged report format plus collision-safe report path.
expectations: Automatically selects the quick tier because the artifact is an idea with no document, repository, or formal proof.
Announces the selected tier and independently launches Prior Art Scout, Reviewer #2, and Methodologist seats before Chair synthesis.
Does not launch Devil's Advocate, Theory Checker, Reproducibility Engineer, or full-tier verification.

Marks quick-tier findings as unverified and produces the unchanged Chair report sections: Verdict, Top findings, Revision plan, Per-reviewer summaries, References, and Appendix: refuted or demoted findings.
Returns the aggregate verdict, three to five highest-priority findings, and a collision-safe council-review-<slug>.md report path.

evals.prompt: Run a full research-council-cdx review of this repository and its formal convergence proof in docs/convergence-proof.tex. Audit whether the implementation matches the theorem assumptions, and independently verify every CRITICAL and MAJOR council finding before the Chair decides the verdict.
evals.expected_output: Honors full tier, runs the complete independent roster, safely audits code and proof, independently verifies serious findings, and preserves the Chair report and cleanup contracts.
expectations: Honors the explicit full tier and uses all six independent reviewer seats plus a fresh neutral Chair.
Includes the absolute repository and proof paths, central claims, field, selected tier, roster, and reproducibility isolation constraints in the intake brief.
Requires the Reproducibility Engineer to use a disposable isolated worktree or prominently fall back to static audit without modifying the user's checkout.
Assigns stable IDs to deduplicated CRITICAL and MAJOR findings and launches independent verifier agents that assume each finding is wrong until supported by direct evidence.
Applies valid verifier verdicts exactly, retains failed verification as unverified, and gives the Chair complete reviewer results paired with verification outcomes.
Produces the unchanged Chair report format and discloses any execution or verification limitation in both the report and concise chat handoff.

evals.prompt: Run a standard research-council-cdx review of my empirical experiment plan. During collection, the Methodologist review file is invalid JSON; its one correction attempt also fails, while the other selected reviewers succeed. Complete the council without inventing the missing review.
evals.expected_output: Uses the standard empirical roster, makes one correction attempt for invalid output, records the missing Methodologist, continues with reduced confidence, and never fabricates the missing review.
expectations: Uses the standard empirical roster: Prior Art Scout, Reviewer #2, Methodologist, Devil's Advocate, Reproducibility Engineer, and Chair.
Uses followup_task exactly once to give the Methodologist the concrete JSON validation error and request correction at the same output path.
Records Methodologist as failed in missing-seats.json and chair/input.json after the correction attempt fails, without asking another persona to replace it.
Continues because at least one independent review succeeded, skips full-tier verification, and marks surviving findings as unverified.
Requires the Chair and final chat handoff to disclose the missing Methodologist perspective and reduced confidence while preserving the exact report section structure.
Cleans up only council-owned scratch state and does not fabricate Methodologist findings or an aggregate result outside the Chair synthesis.
